findings: Requirements doc has zero mention of a refund policy even though cancellation involves payment (booking.payment) — the spec never says whether, or under what conditions, a refund should occur.

The two 'cancel a booking' implementations diverge on refund behavior for the same requirement: api/cancelBooking.ts only refunds if hoursUntil(booking.start) > 24, while admin/cancelBooking.ts calls refund(booking.payment) unconditionally — the same cancellation done through the account page vs. the admin panel produces different refund outcomes (e.g. cancelling 2 hours before start yields no refund via the customer path but a full refund via the admin path).

Neither function checks booking.status before proceeding, so calling cancelBooking/adminCancelBooking on an already-cancelled booking re-runs releaseSlot and refund with no idempotency guard, allowing duplicate refunds from repeated or concurrent calls (double-click, client retry).

In both implementations, booking.status is set to 'cancelled' and releaseSlot(booking.slot) executes before refund(booking.payment) is called, with no error handling shown — if refund() fails, the booking is left cancelled and the slot released with no payment actually refunded and no rollback.
